name_en: MoHE University Student Support Fund - internal grants (full / partial)
name_ar: منح صندوق دعم الطالب الجامعي (منحة كاملة / منحة جزئية)
provider: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research - Directorate of Missions (Student Support)
eligibility_text: Jordanian citizens enrolled in a diploma or bachelor's programme at an official (public) Jordanian higher-education institution (2025/2026 guidance lists 11 eligible universities incl. UJ, Yarmouk, Mutah, Hashemite). Must not hold a full grant from another source or a discount. Previous-semester GPA >= 2/4 (60%); first-semester bachelor students are assessed on Tawjihi average, minimum 65%. Applied online during the announced window using national number + university number; points-based selection with humanitarian-case appeals.
coverage_text: Full grant or partial grant toward university fees; AABU page states the Ministry pays tuition covering 45 credit hours. Amounts of living allowances not stated in the guidance.

sources.title: MoHE Directorate of Missions - Internal grants & loans guidance 2025/2026
AABU - Important Information for the Student (student support)
Hashemite University - Students' Financial Aid
Petra - Nearly 750,000 students benefited from university student fund since 2004 (13 Jul 2026)

notes: Applications open each academic year after MoHE announcement (typically start of first semester). Fund has supported 747,430 students with >JD687.4m 2004-2025 (Petra, Jul 2026). Public universities only.

name_en: MoHE University Student Support Fund - student loans
provider: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research - Directorate of Missions (Student Support)
eligibility_text: Same eligibility and single online application as the MoHE internal grants (Jordanian, official/public university, min 65% Tawjihi for first-semester bachelor students, GPA >= 2/4 thereafter). Loan recipients sign a loan contract with a notarised guarantee.
coverage_text: Loan toward tuition; HU lists 'Student Support Loans (45 credit hours fees)'. Loans were the largest category of the fund (438,953 students 2004-2025).

name_en: Royal Makruma for children of teachers (public universities)
provider: Royal Hashemite Court / Ministry of Education
eligibility_text: Children of (Ministry of Education) teachers admitted to Jordanian public universities via reserved makruma seats.
coverage_text: Exempts recipients from registration fees and other expenses (Jordan Times, Nov 2019). Makruma students ~5% of public university admissions.

name_en: Hashemite University student loans and support fund
eligibility_text: HU students with proven financial need, enrolled at least one semester, no disciplinary penalties, not sponsored/employed by an official entity, not receiving other scholarships; guarantor required. HU Student Support Fund also refunds 60-90% of loans for needy students; student employment requires cumulative avg >= 2.00.
coverage_text: Quarterly or annual loans; repayment starts six months after graduation in monthly instalments. Campus student-employment jobs also available.

sources.title: Hashemite University - Students' Financial Aid

provider: Tamweelcom with Al Hussein Technical University
eligibility_text: One student per year who is a child of a Tamweelcom beneficiary; any HTU programme.
coverage_text: Full tuition for one student annually through HTU's scholarship programme, plus 8-month apprenticeship placements at Tamweelcom.

name_en: Jordanian Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Master's in the US)
eligibility_text: Jordanian residents with a bachelor's from an MoHE-recognised university graded 'Good' or above; excellent English (TOEFL iBT 79+ or ITP 550+). Clinical fields (medicine, dentistry, veterinary) excluded. US dual citizens/Green Card holders ineligible.
coverage_text: Tuition and books, monthly stipend, round-trip flight, travel allowance, visa fees, medical coverage; up to 2 years of master's study.

sources.title: Fulbright Jordan - Jordanian Fulbright Foreign Student Program

notes: Graduate stage - relevant as a long-term goal for Tawjihi grads. 2026 cycle ran 1 Feb - 30 Jun 2026 (closed).

eligibility_text: Exceptional individuals from eligible countries (Jordan appears in Chevening's country selector) for a one-year UK master's. Degree and work-experience requirements are on separate Chevening eligibility pages (not fetched).
